info.title: SpeechNexus workbench API
info.description:
Optional application layer for projects, transcripts, meetings, assistant
turns, teleprompter state, audiobook rendering, saved copies, and exports.

This API is not OpenAI-compatible and never replaces the public speech API.
It calls the speech base through public Job/Artifact APIs and keeps its own
records, staging, outbox, and export artifacts. Every workspace is shared in
P0; no route establishes a user identity or personal private space.

The project/transcript HTTP boundary uses 400 malformed_request or
invalid_request for rejected syntax/parameters, 408 request_timeout for
body intake deadlines, 413 request_too_large for bounded request intake,
and 415 unsupported_media_type for non-UTF-8 JSON writes. Version and
idempotency conflicts are 409 revision_conflict / idempotency_conflict;
invalid_change is 422. Speech import failures retain source_invalid /
source_unsupported (422), source_too_large (413), source_expired (410),
and source_unavailable (503). Absent/deleted resources, including original
create-key replays after deletion, return 404 resource_not_found.
Disabled workbench/storage use 503 workbench_unavailable / store_unavailable.
Uncertain commits use 503 outcome_unknown; preserve the original key and
never automatically create a new intent. Unexpected application or output
validation failures use 500 internal_error.
Meeting routes use the same bounded intake and storage errors. Their
workspace is the server-configured default; clients cannot select it.
Unavailable meeting storage uses 503 meetings_unavailable. A source or
audio-save mode without an installed adapter returns 422
meeting_source_unsupported. Minutes creation uses 503 llm_disabled,
422 llm_profile_mismatch / llm_invalid_input, and 409
llm_source_not_sealed / llm_source_changed / minutes_conflict.
Provider/source failures use 503 llm_unavailable / llm_invalid_response /
llm_source_unavailable. Optional Idempotency-Key pins the original
accepted create/seal/202 snapshot; GET returns current state. Keep the
original key after uncertain outcomes; a request without a key creates
a new intent and must never be automatically retried.
Lists use descending (created_at, id) live keyset pagination. Cursors are
opaque and bound to deployment, resource kind and parent scope; malformed,
altered or mismatched tokens return 400 invalid_cursor, never silently
restart from page one. Changing limit is allowed; newer insertions require
a new first-page read. has_more is true exactly when next_cursor is non-null.
All three deletion operations accept optional workspace_id, defaulting to
the configured deployment workspace; this is query scope, not identity.
Only project/transcript deletion graphs are currently implemented; other
workbench kinds return 422 deletion_resource_unsupported. Foreign owners
return 422 deletion_owner_mismatch. Incomplete confirmations return 422
deletion_confirmation_mismatch; changed/expired plans or blocking dependencies
return 409 deletion_plan_changed / deletion_plan_expired /
deletion_dependency_conflict. Acceptance returns queued intent, not cleanup
completion; same-key replay preserves that original acceptance snapshot.
V2 status and render-unit paths expose approved Minutes configuration and
explicit fixed model bindings. V1 schemas remain strict; v1 render creation
is unavailable without a binding and returns 503 workbench_unavailable
without writing a partial unit. Clients must explicitly select v2.
Errors contain no request
content or internal diagnostics and never imply rollback or remote stop.

post.summary: Create a transcript from a speech artifact or plain text
post.description:
A speech artifact import records its source artifact and receipt. A
manual transcript starts as a draft revision. The workbench never writes
the speech base artifact or Job state.

get.summary: Get a transcript and its current revision

post.description:
Creates a new revision from the expected current head. Sealed revisions
are immutable; a later correction creates another revision and preserves
the source relation. Downstream minutes become stale when their source
revision changes.

post.summary: Create a meeting-minutes job from a sealed transcript
post.description:
LLM integration is optional and disabled by default. Only a sealed
transcript revision is accepted. The model and template revisions are
pinned. Failure does not modify the transcript.

post.summary: Submit a speech Job for a render unit

get.description:
The state is scoped to one project. A 404 means the project is unknown or no
state has been saved yet; a missing state is not position zero and must not
be reported as a successful empty state.

put.summary: Update teleprompter position and manual takeover
put.description:
The state stores the script revision and position. Matches from an older
script revision or stream epoch must not move the current position.

post.summary: Copy a committed speech artifact into a project
post.description:
Downloads the speech artifact through the public API, verifies its
digest and receipt, then writes a workbench-owned copy. A base artifact
expiration or deletion never mutates the speech Job; the workbench copy
has its own lifecycle. The request pins both the source Artifact and
its receipt; the persisted copy must equal the verified source digest,
byte count, and receipt.

get.description:
Audiobooks are listed newest first. Reading order inside a book is carried
by explicit ordinals, not by this listing order.

Chapters are listed newest first. Reading order is carried by the explicit
chapter ordinal, not by this listing order.

Render units are listed newest first; the explicit unit ordinal carries
the position inside the chapter's render plan.

post.description:
Pins text, voice, pronunciation, model, and profile revisions. The
speech base only receives a bounded text unit Job; the workbench owns
chapter and book composition.
This legacy version cannot express the required model binding. The
production boundary returns 503 workbench_unavailable without writes;
use createRenderUnitV2 with the caller-selected binding.

patch.description:
A changed text, voice, pronunciation, model, or profile creates a new
unit revision and marks dependent output stale. Unchanged units remain
reusable.

post.summary: Create an assistant turn and speech job
post.description:
The workbench controls the business turn. It calls the public speech Job
API for text-to-speech; the speech base does not create assistant turns.

Requires every required render unit to have a saved copy whose source
revisions match the requested manifest. The export is workbench-owned
and never creates or modifies speech-base JobStep or Artifact records.
When `unit_ids` is supplied, it must select at least one unit.

get.summary: List published voices visible to the deployment
get.description:
A read-through of the speech base's authoritative published voice catalogue.
Identity, revision number, status, source type and formats are the base's values
reported verbatim: the workbench neither renumbers a revision nor re-derives a
status, and it never designs, clones, validates, publishes or retires a voice on
the base's behalf. The cursor is the base's own opaque value and must be sent back
unchanged, so a workbench listing cursor is never accepted here.

get.summary: Get one immutable published voice revision
get.description:
Reports one published revision exactly as the base holds it, including the model
binding the base pinned for it. An unknown, unpublished or discarded revision is
not found; the workbench never serves a draft as if it were published.

get.summary: Get one immutable voice revision with its complete disable reason
get.description:
Reports one published revision exactly as the base holds it, including the model
binding the base pinned for it. An unknown, unpublished or discarded revision is
not found; the workbench never serves a draft as if it were published.
Unlike the frozen v1 projection, disabled_reason preserves up to 2000 characters.

Render units are listed newest first; the explicit unit ordinal carries
the position inside the chapter's render plan.

get.description: Reads only the workbench's committed immutable copy, never the speech source. Validates its complete stored byte count and SHA-256 before sending content. Supports one closed, open-ended or suffix byte range; malformed/empty ranges return 400, unsatisfiable ranges return 416 with Content-Range bytes */size. Successful replies include Content-Length, Accept-Ranges bytes and a strong ETag equal to the quoted stored SHA-256. 206 includes Content-Range. Unavailable storage, verification or local download capacity returns 503; content beyond the deployment's bounded download limit returns 413. The source's lifetime does not expire an independently committed saved copy. A non-completed export returns 409; an expired export returns 410.

VoiceCursor.name: after
VoiceCursor.description: The speech base's own opaque catalogue cursor, returned unchanged.

XRequestId.description: Validated client request ID or a server-generated correlation ID.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying cancellation coordination.

llm_enabled.description: True only when a deployment-approved intranet LLM is configured.

shared_deployment_notice.description: UI must localize this code as "all workspaces are shared within this deployment; no personal isolation is implied".

External_shared_errors_schema_json_Opera.description: Query GET /v1/nexus/operations/{operation_id}. This identity is the original execution; retrying never creates a second execution.

External_shared_identifiers_schema_json_.description: Opaque stable resource identifier. Prefixes are descriptive, not authorization claims.

External_shared_receipts_schema_json_Pub.description: Allowlisted public projection only. Omit content, prompt, instructions, vendor payloads and private runtime identities. Unknown facts go into stable missing/unknown paths, never arbitrary dictionaries.

External_shared_identifiers_schema_json_.description: Monotonic decimal revision represented as a string.

expected_source_revision.description: When supplied, a new intent requires this exact Meeting sealed revision; otherwise llm_source_changed. Accepted same-key same-body intents replay before current source/profile checks. Omission preserves legacy behavior.

artifact.description:
Present only when the export succeeds. The artifact must belong to
this export and pin exactly this job's manifest revision.

manifest_revision.description:
Immutable export manifest used to produce this artifact. It must
equal the owning ExportJob manifest_revision.

llm_enabled.description: True only when a deployment-approved intranet LLM is configured.

minutes_profile.description: Public approved Minutes profile. An absent or null profile disables new Minutes creation in consumers; never infer a template or model. Accepted intents remain replayable independently of the current profile.

shared_deployment_notice.description: UI must localize this code as "all workspaces are shared within this deployment; no personal isolation is implied".

External_shared_identifiers_schema_json_.description: Monotonic decimal SSE event sequence used as Last-Event-ID.

data.description: Event-type-specific payload; see the concrete ExportEvent variant.

Unauthorized.description: Shared service credential required or invalid.

RequestTimeout.description: Request body receive deadline exceeded before application dispatch.

PayloadTooLarge.description: Request body or referenced source exceeds the configured bounded intake.

InternalServerError.description: Unexpected application or response validation failure; no automatic mutation retry.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Workbench or optional LLM dependency unavailable.

Conflict.description: Revision mismatch, idempotency conflict, or incompatible lifecycle transition.

UnprocessableEntity.description: Invalid source, unsupported unit composition, or feature disabled.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: This operation requires application/json with UTF-8 encoding.

TooManyRequests.description: Queue or quota limit exceeded; follow Retry-After.

RangeNotSatisfiable.description: The single requested byte range cannot select content.

SharedServiceKey.description: Optional deployment-wide shared credential; not a user identity.
